question: 列出所有产品型号和名称
sql: SELECT model_code, name FROM products ORDER BY model_code LIMIT 200

question: 按型号统计已完成订单的销售件数
sql: SELECT p.model_code, SUM(oi.quantity) AS sold_units FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id=o.id JOIN products p ON p.id=oi.product_id WHERE o.status='completed' GROUP BY p.model_code ORDER BY sold_units DESC LIMIT 200

question: 各团队解决的工单数量是多少
sql: SELECT tm.name AS team_name, COUNT(*) AS resolved_ticket_count FROM tickets t JOIN agents a ON a.id=t.assigned_agent_id JOIN teams tm ON tm.id=a.team_id WHERE t.status='resolved' GROUP BY tm.name ORDER BY resolved_ticket_count DESC LIMIT 200
